name: Liminal Fetchling

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: You come from a line of fetchlings with a closer connection to the Ethereal Plane and Netherworld, and you share those realms' affinity with the in-between and unseen. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to locate Undetected creatures within 60 feet when using the Seek action. Your flat check to target Concealed creatures is DC 3 Flat check instead of DC 5, and your flat check to target undetected creatures is DC 9 Flat check instead of DC 11.
